topic: Online Admission Registration Form and Payment Process
summary: This topic details the functionality of the online registration form for new admissions, covering student data entry, online fee payment, and the subsequent flow of this information into the ERP system, including receipt generation and email notifications.
steps: A prospective student accesses and fills out the online registration form, providing personal details (name, photo, gender, email, phone number, etc.).
The student proceeds to make the online registration fee payment (e.g., 10,000 INR).
The integrated payment gateway (e.g., Razorpay) processes the transaction.
Upon successful payment, the student's application entry appears in the ERP under 'Admission Screen' > 'Application Data'.
A payment receipt is generated and displayed.
The system will be configured to automatically send the payment receipt and prospectus to the student's registered email ID (future enhancement, pending confirmation).
business_rules: The registration fee is a fixed amount (e.g., 10,000 INR).
Payment gateway charges (e.g., GST, bank charges) may be applied to the student's transaction.
The phone number field on the form will have a restriction (e.g., up to 12 digits) to prevent incorrect entries.
The admission number will be generated after the payment is confirmed and the entry is fetched into the ERP.
important_notes: The online registration form is currently in a 'test gate' mode; it needs to be made 'live' for actual payment deductions.
The institution's logo will be integrated into the payment receipt.
Discussion is required regarding the automatic emailing of receipts to students due to potential refund complexities.
The ERP team will provide a timeline for making the form live and for training the admission team.
